title: Day of Year Calculator
h1: Day of Year Calculator — Ordinal Date
seoTitle: Day of Year Calculator — Ordinal Date
description: Find the day number of a date, days remaining in the year, and whether the year is a leap year. Uses your local calendar and runs offline.
intro: Pick a date to see its ordinal day (1–366), how many days are left after it, and the leap-year status of that year.
blurb: Get the ordinal day of a date and the days left in that year.
howItWorks: The date is read as a local calendar date, not a UTC timestamp.
Day of year is the difference from January 1 of the same year, plus one.
February 29 is included only when the year is a leap year.
examples: 2024-12-31 is day 366 because 2024 is a leap year.

faq.a: The date input is a calendar date. Day numbers are calculated from that year, month and day without shifting zones.

faq.q: What counts as a leap year?
faq.a: Years divisible by 4 are leap years, except century years, which must be divisible by 400.
